proposition: According to Melvin-Koushki, the 12th/18th-century biographer Mirza ʿAbd Allah Afandi assumed Ibn Turka was a mystical philosopher of Shiʿi stock yet named only the Mafahis and described it as comprising the mystical sciences in an occult mode; he saw an early copy made two years after its completion.

mediation.note: A single Shiʿi-oriented bio-bibliographer of the early 18th century.
Reported through MK, who argues a rival reading.
